pylons_vi: 2 tháp chữ H (hai cột đứng, dầm ngang trên ở khoảng giữa chiều cao), cao 116,5 m
pylons_en: 2 H-shaped pylons (two vertical columns, one upper cross-beam at about mid-height), 116.5 m

pylon_custom.description: H pylon: two vertical, parallel rectangular RC columns outside the deck edges, a lower crossbeam under the deck and one deep upper strut at about mid-height above the deck; flat heads; semi-fan stays in two planes anchored on the columns from about 31 m to 61 m above the deck; rectangular pile cap at the waterline.
reference_images: https://vnexpress.net/cau-rach-mieu-2-hop-long-4875889.html (DSC05579: on-deck view of the H strut)

model3d.notes: Round 7 (research/model-review/brief-r7-rach-mieu-2.md): H pylon with a deep upper strut at ≈53% of the above-deck height (VnExpress closure aerial and on-deck photo; pass 2 missed it). No auxiliary piers: the pier pass 2 read as one is the anchor pier 120 m from each pylon, and the next pier is the first approach pier (Commons elevation, PLO, Tạp chí GTVT). Pylon ≈66 m above a deck ≈40 m above water at the pylons; deck 36 m at the anchor piers with a ≈6 m vertical curve; stays anchored ≈31–61 m above the deck (Commons elevation, scaled from the 270 m span). Rectangular pile cap ≈22 × 34 m from 24 Ø2.0 m piles. Deck width 21.5 m (VnExpress, Trung Nam; client-confirmed 2026-11-28), columns at z = ±13; 17.5 m (Wikipedia, ground-breaking) superseded.
